item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Lads, a few things. First of all, I have not read it yet- I'm writing this in the twenty minutes of freetime I have between school and a full shift at work. I want you all to understand the magnitude of this:

We only need one more bottledick tale for it to be a canon.

That's right. So far we have Second Date, Third Date, Coffee Date, and then this tale, which again I have only skimmed so far that I saw the words "Gears" and "Dick stuck in a bottle", which fills me with warmth and pride. I have been shitposting in this fandom for years and never before have I seen such a lovely coming together of an online community around the one thing that brings us all together: memes.

A second thing to bring up here is that I'm going to copy and paste the reasoning for these tales from my comment on Clef's extension, for those just entering this wondering why the sweet hell these exist:
+ show drama
- Hide drama

For a further explanation: I wrote the first entry of this as a one shot a month ago after hearing a funny tumblr audio post describing the bottledick situation. It quickly amassed 50 upvotes, which is 49 more than I expected. It also caused my first ever death threats and hate mail.

Tonight, a month after posting "Second Date", I received the most potent death threat I've ever received from the same person calling me a worthless dumb bitch and telling me that I should go kill myself, which is again, not the first time they sent me something like this. I responded saying that if this is about the stupid fucking bottledick kondraki tale again I would do backflips. It also just so happens that this same anon (I assume), who seems to think that such Filth as gay characters and a funny tale about dicks is destroying the wiki, also sent Clef a message asking how he could have the audacity to allow such gay content, how dare he. Clef did not like this and published this tonight in response and it's fucking hilarious.

So far the anon has delivered on his blog in response. I'm sure there will be more of this strange bottledick anon to come.

We only need one more tale for this to be immortalized in stone and I can't believe it. I'm thinking about naming it "Crotch Peas Canon", but I'm open to suggestions. "Bottledick" is almost too revealing of what is held inside; what do we want visitors to see on the canon dropdown menu? Should we disguise it as quality wiki content and have it slap them in the face when they enter like a terrible kinder egg, or should we create a guise of transparency on what they're about to experience? So many options.
